description: This file contains unit tests for the VoicePushToTalk component in the OpenClaw project. It tests functions related to delta computation and attributed color comparison in the VoicePushToTalk module.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for the VoicePushToTalk module.

methods.name: `delta trims committed prefix`
methods.description: Tests that the delta correctly trims the committed prefix.

methods.name: `delta falls back when prefix differs`
methods.description: Tests that the delta function falls back to returning the entire current string when the prefix differs.

methods.name: `attributed colors differ when not final`
methods.description: Checks that attributed colors are different when the final flag is false.

methods.name: `attributed colors match when final`
methods.description: Checks that attributed colors match when the final flag is true.
